related.title: 超導磁體低溫系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」與「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超導磁體低溫系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" and "Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦27 km 超導對撞機的磁剛度、亮度、1.9 K 低溫、機器保護與試運轉工程；超導磁體低溫系統則以NbTi/Nb₃Sn 臨界面、4 K 熱負載預算、電流引線、失超保護與持續電流運轉為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on magnetic rigidity, luminosity, 1.9 K cryogenics, machine protection and commissioning of a 27 km superconducting collider; Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets centres on NbTi/Nb3Sn critical surface, 4 K heat-load budget, current leads, quench protection and persistent-mode operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」與「NbTi 導體工作點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導磁體低溫系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「失超偵測、儲能 ½LI² 與氦氣釋放」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” and “NbTi conductor operating point”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quench detection, stored energy ½LI² and helium release", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: CERN 大型強子對撞機
history.text: LHC 於 1994 年獲 CERN 理事會核准，建在 1989 到 2000 年運轉的 LEP 正負電子對撞機留下的 26.7 km 隧道中，以 1.9 K 超流氦冷卻的 NbTi 雙孔徑磁鐵達到 LEP 隧道半徑下所需的 8.33 T。2008 年 9 月 10 日首次有束流循環，九天後一個匯流排接頭電阻過高引發電弧與氦洩漏，修復一年後於 2009 年底重新啟動；2012 年 7 月 ATLAS 與 CMS 宣布發現希格斯玻色子，Run 2（2015–2018）在 6.5 TeV 運轉，Run 3 自 2022 年起以 6.8 TeV 達到 13.6 TeV 的對撞能量。高亮度 LHC 升級將以 Nb₃Sn 四極磁鐵與蟹形腔把亮度再提高五倍以上。本課只重建公開的設計原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: The LHC was approved by the CERN Council in 1994 and built in the 26.7 km tunnel left by the LEP electron-positron collider that ran from 1989 to 2000, using twin-aperture NbTi magnets cooled by 1.9 K superfluid helium to reach the 8.33 T demanded by the LEP tunnel radius. Beam first circulated on 10 September 2008; nine days later a bus-bar splice with excessive resistance arced and released helium, and after a year of repairs the machine restarted at the end of 2009. ATLAS and CMS announced the Higgs boson in July 2012, Run 2 (2015–2018) operated at 6.5 TeV, and Run 3 from 2022 reaches 13.6 TeV collisions at 6.8 TeV per beam. The High-Luminosity LHC upgrade will raise luminosity by more than a factor of five with Nb₃Sn quadrupoles and crab cavities. This course reconstructs only public design principles and engineering logic.

history.text: 本課把「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」到「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。

vendors.name: 歐洲核子研究組織
vendors.business: LHC 的研究與設施營運方公開資料，供認識磁鐵、低溫、射頻與控制等大型科學服務；不是商業加速器供應商清單。 作為公開產品／服務的學習關聯，不是本課的採購或承攬名單。
vendors.businessEn: The LHC research and facility operator’s public information connects magnets, cryogenics, RF and controls; it is not a commercial accelerator vendor list. This is a public product/service learning reference, not a procurement or contractor list for this course.

vendors.name: 布魯克
vendors.business: 科學儀器集團，螢光顯微部門提供 Luxendo 系列光片顯微鏡與多光子系統。
vendors.businessEn: Scientific-instrument group whose fluorescence-microscopy unit offers the Luxendo light-sheet line and multiphoton systems.

vendors.name: 液化空氣
vendors.business: 工業與醫療氣體、氣體技術與服務，供應研究設施所需的氖、二氧化碳等純氣體。
vendors.businessEn: Industrial and medical gases, gas technologies and services, supplying pure gases such as neon and CO₂ to research facilities.

vendors.name: 海克斯康
vendors.business: 座標量測機、光學探頭與量測軟體。
vendors.businessEn: Coordinate measuring machines, optical probes and metrology software.
